tools.name: list-stores
tools.description:
List verified UCP stores, optionally filtered by category and minimum score.

    Use when the user wants to shop by category — e.g., "find me a pet store"
    or "what shoe stores are available?"

    Returns stores sorted by score (highest first) with domain, category, score, and grade.

category.description: Filter by store category (e.g., "footwear", "pet supplies"). Use list-categories to see available categories.

min_score.description: Minimum total score to include (default: 50). Lower values return more stores but may include lower-quality ones.

limit.description: Maximum number of stores to return (default: 10, max: 50)

tools.name: list-categories
tools.description:
List all available store categories with store counts.

    Use to discover what kinds of stores are available before narrowing down.
    Returns categories sorted by number of stores (most stores first).

tools.name: check-domain
tools.description:
Check if a domain supports Universal Commerce Protocol (UCP).

    Returns the UCP status, manifest version, capabilities, response latency,
    and AI bot access policies (GPTBot, ClaudeBot, Google-Extended, etc.).

    The domain is automatically normalized (removes protocol, www, paths).
    Examples: "shopify.com", "https://www.example.com/path" → "example.com"

domain.description: The domain to check for UCP support (e.g., "shopify.com", "example.com"). Protocol, www prefix, and paths are automatically removed.

tools.name: discover-store
tools.description:
Discover available shopping tools on a UCP-enabled store.

    Connects to the store's MCP endpoint and lists all available
    tools (search, cart, shipping, etc.). Use this to understand
    what a store supports before shopping.

    Example: domain: "allbirds.com"

tools.name: search-catalog
tools.description:
Search for products on any UCP-enabled Shopify store.

    Searches the store's live product catalog via UCP/MCP and returns
    matching products with titles, prices, variants, and images.

    Examples:
    - domain: "allbirds.com", query: "tree topper"
    - domain: "gymshark.com", query: "hoodie"

domain.description: The store domain (e.g., "allbirds.com", "gymshark.com"). Must be a UCP-enabled Shopify store.

country.description: ISO country code for localized pricing/inventory (e.g., "US", "GB", "CA"). Optional — defaults to store default.

tools.name: search-all
tools.description:
Search for products across all verified UCP stores at once.

    Fans out the query to multiple stores concurrently and returns
    aggregated results grouped by store. Fast stores respond first;
    slow/failing stores are skipped gracefully.

    Example: query: "running shoes", maxStores: 5

country.description: ISO country code for localized pricing (e.g., "US", "GB"). Optional.

maxStores.description: Maximum number of stores to search (default: 5, max: 10)

tools.name: search-policies
tools.description:
Search store policies on any UCP-enabled Shopify store.

    Query return policies, shipping policies, refund policies, privacy policies,
    terms of service, or any other store policy. Returns the matching policy text.

    Use this when a user asks about a store's policies before or after purchase —
    e.g., "what is the return policy?", "do they offer free shipping?", "refund window?"

    Example: domain: "allbirds.com", query: "return policy"

query.description: Policy search term (e.g., "return policy", "shipping", "refund window", "privacy policy")

tools.name: get-product-details
tools.description:
Get full product details including variant IDs from a UCP-enabled store.

    Use this after search-catalog to resolve variant IDs needed for add-to-cart.
    Pass the Product ID from search results to get all variants with their IDs.

    Example: domain: "allbirds.com", productId: "gid://shopify/Product/123456"

productId.description: The product ID from search-catalog results (e.g., "gid://shopify/Product/123456")

tools.name: add-to-cart
tools.description:
Add a product to cart on any UCP-enabled Shopify store and get a checkout URL.

    Requires a variant ID from the search-catalog or get-product-details results.
    Returns the cart contents, checkout URL, and a cart_id token.

    To build multi-item carts: pass the returned cart_id back on subsequent calls.
    The agent holds the cart_id — no server-side session needed.

    Example: domain: "allbirds.com", variantId: "gid://shopify/ProductVariant/12345"
    Multi-item: domain: "allbirds.com", variantId: "...", cartId: "gid://shopify/Cart/abc123"

variantId.description: The product variant ID from search-catalog results (e.g., "gid://shopify/ProductVariant/12345")

country.description: ISO country code for localized pricing/checkout (e.g., "US", "GB", "CA"). Optional.

cartId.description: Cart token from a previous add-to-cart call. Pass this to add more items to an existing cart instead of creating a new one.

tools.name: build-bundle
tools.description:
Build a multi-store shopping cart in one call.

    Pass an array of items (each with domain + variantId) and get back
    per-store checkout URLs. Items on the same store share one cart.

    Requires variant IDs — use get-product-details first to resolve sizes/colors.

    Example: items: [
      { "domain": "allbirds.com", "variantId": "gid://shopify/ProductVariant/123" },
      { "domain": "gymshark.com", "variantId": "gid://shopify/ProductVariant/456", "quantity": 2 }
    ]

items.description: Array of items to add to carts. Items on the same domain share one cart.

country.description: ISO country code for localized pricing/checkout (e.g., "US", "GB"). Applied to all items.

resources.name: verified-stores
resources.description:
List of all verified UCP-enabled stores available for shopping.
    Each store has been confirmed to have a valid UCP manifest and
    working MCP endpoint. Use these domains with search-catalog
    and add-to-cart tools.

prompts.name: shop-for-product
prompts.description:
Guide the user through finding and purchasing a product on any UCP-enabled store.
    Walks through the full agentic commerce flow: search, select, add to cart, checkout.

arguments.name: product
arguments.description: What product to search for (e.g., "black running shorts", "wool runners")

arguments.name: store
arguments.description: Store domain to search (e.g., "allbirds.com", "gymshark.com"). Optional — agent can suggest stores.

arguments.name: country
arguments.description: ISO country code for localized pricing (e.g., "US", "GB"). Optional.

prompts.name: compare-stores
prompts.description:
Check multiple store domains for UCP/agentic commerce support.
    Useful for comparing which brands in a category are AI-ready.

arguments.name: domains
arguments.description: Comma-separated list of domains to check (e.g., "allbirds.com, gymshark.com, lululemon.com")

arguments.name: category
arguments.description: Category label for the comparison (e.g., "activewear", "footwear", "DTC brands")

findings.title: Injection reflected — 'list-stores.category'
findings.description: Payload was reflected verbatim in the response without sanitization (field classification: sql).
findings.evidence:
# UCP Stores: "' OR '1'='1"

No stores found matching your criteria.

**Next steps**: Use **list-categories** to see available categories.
findings.remediation: Sanitize and validate all input parameters. Never pass raw user input to shell commands, file paths, or SQL queries.

findings.title: Token Exposure — server version disclosure in HTTP response headers
findings.description: HTTP response header 'server: cloudflare' discloses internal information.
findings.remediation: Remove the 'server' response header in production.

findings.title: MCP server exposes tools with completable arguments
findings.description: 9 tool(s) have schema properties that may support completion/complete enumeration.
findings.remediation: Review which argument values are exposed via completion/complete.

findings.title: Prompt template injection confirmed in 'shop-for-product'
findings.description: prompts/get for 'shop-for-product' reflected the injection payload verbatim in the returned messages, confirming unsanitized argument reflection.
findings.evidence: Payload reflected in messages: {"description": "    Guide the user through finding and purchasing a product on any UCP-enabled store.\n    Walks through the full agentic commerce flow: search, select, add to cart, checkout.", "messages": [{"role": "user", "content": {"type": "text", "text": "Help me shop for CORVUS_INJECTION_TEST
findings.remediation: Sanitize prompt arguments before embedding them in message templates.

findings.title: Server accepts path traversal cursor without validation
findings.description: tools/list accepted cursor='../../../../etc/passwd' and returned a result instead of rejecting it. This may indicate missing cursor validation.
findings.remediation: Validate cursor values; reject non-opaque or path-like cursor strings.
